Capture abandonment reasons with timestamps, context (device, location, interruptions), and emotional state. Use insights to propose copy, IA, and autosave visibility changes.
completion_markers: Recruit 15 participants with at least 2 draft abandons in the last 30 days
Daily prompts delivered and response rate ≥ 80% across the study window
Thematic analysis completed with at least 6 themes and supporting quotes
Actionable recommendations mapped to funnel metric impact and error budget constraints
start_conditions: Baseline analytics for draft start vs submit available for the last 8 weeks
Diary tool configured (prompt schedule, privacy settings, export)
Participant incentive budget set at $200 per participant
Autosave and draft retention behavior documented by engineering

Validate with quick-turn user interviews (n=6) plus an A/B test plan for production. Ensure copy is plain-language and avoids overpromising on data access limits.
completion_markers: 3 microcopy variants written with rationale and reading level target (≤ Grade 8)
6 interviews completed with comprehension questions and recorded consent
A/B test plan created including primary metric, guardrails, and error budget definition
Final variant packaged in Figma with redlines for engineering
start_conditions: Baseline connect funnel metrics and weekly ticket volume snapshot
List of requested OAuth scopes and plain-language descriptions from engineering
Legal review path confirmed for permission-related claims
Ability to run an experiment via feature flag or experimentation platform

Create a support runbook for key misconfiguration scenarios (e.g., disabled key, denied decrypt) including expected error codes. Align the policy with contractual security addendum language where applicable.
completion_markers: Policy page published in internal docs and linked from enterprise onboarding checklist
Support runbook includes at least 5 failure modes with step-by-step remediation
Legal/security review recorded with version number and effective date
start_conditions: Engineering confirms current envelope encryption design and tenancy model
Support leadership agrees on escalation path and on-call ownership
Legal provides standard security addendum clauses related to customer-managed keys

title: Quarterly access review (UAR) for finance systems + evidence logging
description: Perform the quarterly user access review for finance systems (ERP, payments portal, and invoicing admin), ensuring leavers are removed and role assignments match job function. Collect manager attestations and store evidence in a centralized, read-only audit folder. Track exceptions (temporary access) with expiry dates and ticket references.
completion_markers: 100% of in-scope users reviewed with manager attestation recorded
All terminated users removed within 24 hours of review completion (verified in system logs)
Exceptions list contains expiry dates and associated tickets for each exception
start_conditions: In-scope system list and role definitions are confirmed by finance IT
HR roster export available (current employees + terminated in last quarter)
Audit folder permissions set to security + auditors only

title: Launch GA4 + BigQuery pipeline for paid social cohort ROI (Meta + TikTok) with source-of-truth in Looker
description: Stand up a clean analytics path from GA4 to BigQuery and publish a Looker dashboard that attributes cohort LTV by paid channel for Meta Ads and TikTok Ads. Upstream dependencies include GA4 event schema and UTM governance; downstream consumers are Looker explores and weekly growth readouts in Notion. Include sanity checks against Stripe revenue and ensure time-zone alignment (America/Los_Angeles) for daily reporting. Document the data model and known caveats (e.g., iOS SKAN gaps).
completion_markers: BigQuery dataset contains GA4 export tables with at least 30 days of backfill and daily scheduled loads
Looker dashboard published with cohort ROI by channel, campaign, and landing page, reviewed by Growth lead
Data validation report shows <3% variance vs Stripe net revenue for the same period (documented exceptions)
Event/UTM schema doc stored in Confluence and linked from the dashboard
start_conditions: GA4 property access granted and BigQuery linking enabled
UTM parameter standards approved (source/medium/campaign/content/term)
Stripe read-only access or export available for revenue reconciliation
Looker project permissions provisioned for the analytics service account

title: A/B test new pricing page hero + FAQ order using Optimizely with downstream impact tracked in Amplitude
description: Design and implement an A/B test on the pricing page that changes the hero value proposition and reorders the FAQ to reduce bounce and increase trial starts. Upstream dependency is Optimizely Full Stack experiment configuration; downstream dependency is Amplitude event instrumentation for "pricing_view", "cta_click", and "trial_start". Use a minimum detectable effect of 6% on trial starts with a 14-day runtime and guardrail metrics for page speed (Web Vitals). Coordinate with Brand for copy constraints and legal disclaimer placement.
completion_markers: Experiment launched in Optimizely with 50/50 traffic split and audience targeting documented
Amplitude dashboard shows variant metrics with consistent event counts (<2% discrepancy vs server logs)
Statistical readout completed with decision memo (ship/iterate/rollback) posted in Slack #growth
Web Vitals (LCP, CLS) do not regress by more than 10% vs control
start_conditions: Optimizely SDK integrated on pricing page and QA environment available
Amplitude tracking plan updated and reviewed by analytics
Baseline conversion rate and traffic volumes confirmed for power calculation
Brand/legal sign-off on copy and disclaimers

title: Rebuild lead-to-MQL scoring in HubSpot using Clearbit firmographics and route to Salesforce campaigns
description: Update lead scoring rules in HubSpot to incorporate Clearbit firmographic enrichment (industry, employee count, region) and route qualified leads into Salesforce as MQLs tied to specific Campaigns. Upstream dependency is Clearbit enrichment availability and mapping; downstream dependency is Salesforce campaign member sync and SDR assignment rules in LeanData. Include a fallback path when Clearbit returns null and add a "data_quality" flag for reporting. Provide a short enablement guide for SDRs explaining why a lead scored and how to prioritize.
completion_markers: HubSpot scoring model updated with documented weights and thresholds for MQL
Clearbit fields mapped and populating for >85% of new inbound leads over 7 days
Salesforce Campaign Member records created with correct campaign attribution for MQLs
LeanData routing rules tested with at least 10 sample leads and validated by SDR manager
start_conditions: Admin access to HubSpot workflows and properties
Clearbit API key active and enrichment fields defined
Salesforce campaign structure agreed (naming, status values)
LeanData rules owner available for QA window

title: Email deliverability warm-up for new sending domain via SendGrid with downstream monitoring in Postmaster Tools
description: Warm up a new marketing sending domain in SendGrid to improve inbox placement for lifecycle campaigns. Upstream dependency is DNS configuration (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) managed in Cloudflare; downstream dependency is monitoring via Google Postmaster Tools and SendGrid Engagement reports. Implement a 4-week ramp plan segmented by engaged recipients first, with content variations to reduce spam complaints. Provide a runbook for pausing sends if complaint rate exceeds 0.2% or if reputation drops.
completion_markers: SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records verified in SendGrid and pass authentication checks
Warm-up schedule executed for 4 weeks with daily volume logs stored in a shared sheet
Postmaster Tools shows domain reputation at least 'Medium' and spam rate <0.1% for 7 consecutive days
Runbook published with thresholds, rollback steps, and owner escalation path
start_conditions: Cloudflare access to modify DNS and propagate records
SendGrid dedicated IP (or pool decision) confirmed
Suppression lists imported and engaged segment defined in the CDP
Seed list and inbox placement monitoring set up (Gmail/Outlook/Yahoo)

title: Build partner referral tracking with Impact.com and downstream revenue reconciliation in NetSuite
description: Implement partner referral tracking using Impact.com links and ensure downstream reconciliation of referral-driven revenue in NetSuite. Upstream dependency is Impact.com integration with the website (link redirects + tracking template); downstream dependency is NetSuite revenue reporting by referral source for finance. Create a partner onboarding kit including link generation steps, allowed promotional claims, and brand assets. Validate attribution with a test partner and confirm conversion events fire server-side to reduce ad blocker loss.
completion_markers: Impact.com tracking links live on site with verified click and conversion events in the console
NetSuite monthly report includes a referral-source dimension that ties to Impact partner IDs
Partner onboarding kit delivered (PDF + shared folder) and approved by Partnerships lead
End-to-end test completed: click → signup → paid conversion attributed to a test partner
start_conditions: Impact.com account provisioned and partner program structure defined
Engineering time allocated for server-side conversion endpoint (if required)
NetSuite reporting owner confirms field mapping approach
Legal approves partner terms and promotional guidelines

title: Retargeting audience hygiene: sync product-qualified segments from Segment CDP to Google Ads & LinkedIn
description: Create and maintain clean retargeting audiences based on product-qualified actions (e.g., created workspace, invited teammate) and sync them from Segment CDP to Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager. Upstream dependency is Segment identity resolution and event taxonomy; downstream dependency is audience size and match rate reporting inside each ad platform. Add exclusion logic for current customers based on billing status from the data warehouse. Include a weekly audit to catch audience drift when event names change.
completion_markers: Three audiences (PQL-7d, PQL-30d, Pricing-Visitors-14d) created in Segment and syncing successfully
Google Ads and LinkedIn show stable audience population with match rate >= 40% within 10 days
Customer exclusion segment reduces paid spend on existing customers by at least 15% (baseline comparison documented)
Weekly audience audit checklist created and scheduled with owners
start_conditions: Segment destinations for Google Ads and LinkedIn authenticated
Event taxonomy finalized for PQL actions and validated in Amplitude/warehouse
Billing status table available in Snowflake (or equivalent) for exclusions
Consent/Privacy review completed for ad audience usage

title: Blocked: migrate blog from WordPress to Webflow without breaking SEO, using upstream 301 map and downstream Search Console validation
description: Plan and execute a content migration from WordPress to Webflow, preserving URL structure where possible and implementing a comprehensive 301 redirect map. Upstream dependency is a complete inventory export from WordPress (posts, categories, tags) and the redirect mapping spreadsheet; downstream dependency is Google Search Console coverage and sitemap submission. Identify high-traffic pages via Ahrefs and ensure canonical tags, schema markup, and image alt text carry over. Validate page speed after migration and address any indexation drops.
completion_markers: Redirect map implemented with >= 98% of legacy URLs returning 301 to correct destinations
Search Console shows no sustained increase in 404s after 14 days (threshold: <20 new 404s/day)
Top 50 organic landing pages retain at least 90% of pre-migration clicks after 30 days
New XML sitemap submitted and indexed, with coverage report exported for records
start_conditions: WordPress admin export completed (content + media) and stored in shared drive
Webflow templates finalized and approved by Brand
Access granted to DNS/hosting to change routing and SSL settings
Search Console verified ownership for the domain

title: Cancelled: influencer seeding pilot on TikTok Shop due to upstream fulfillment constraints in ShipBob
description: Run a small influencer seeding pilot using TikTok Shop creators to generate UGC and track incremental sales. Upstream dependency would have been ShipBob inventory availability and kitting lead times; downstream would have been TikTok Shop reporting and Shopify order tagging for attribution. The pilot is cancelled because fulfillment SLAs and stock allocation could not be guaranteed for the test window. Document the cancellation rationale and propose a revisit criterion tied to inventory buffers.
completion_markers: Cancellation note posted in the campaign doc with date, decision owner, and constraints
Revisit criteria defined (e.g., 6 weeks of safety stock + ShipBob kitting SLA under 5 days)
All creator outreach drafts and discount codes archived and disabled
Stakeholders notified in Slack and calendar holds released
start_conditions: TikTok Shop account would need to be active with product catalog synced from Shopify
ShipBob stock allocation and kitting plan would need sign-off from Ops
Tracking plan for attribution would need agreement from analytics
Creator shortlist and budget would need approval from Finance

title: Blocked: implement in-app referral prompt triggered by activation milestone, dependent on LaunchDarkly flagging
description: Add an in-app referral prompt that appears after a user hits an activation milestone (e.g., completes first project) and A/B test incentive framing. Upstream dependency is LaunchDarkly feature flags for controlled rollout; downstream dependency is Mixpanel funnels and Braze follow-up emails for non-converters. Ensure the prompt respects localization (EN/DE/ES) and does not appear to enterprise tenants flagged as "no_marketing" in Salesforce. This is blocked until the engineering team finishes migrating the flag SDK version.
completion_markers: LaunchDarkly flag created with targeting rules (by plan, locale, tenant type) and QA evidence
Mixpanel events implemented (referral_prompt_view, referral_link_copy, referral_signup) with schema doc
Braze canvas set up for follow-up with holdout group and suppression rules
Experiment results summarized with conversion lift and impact on activation churn
start_conditions: Activation milestone definition finalized and available as a product event
LaunchDarkly SDK migration completed and stable in production
Salesforce tenant attributes synced to product (no_marketing, plan tier)
Localization strings delivered by Content team

title: Cancelled: expand Reddit Ads spend for niche subreddits after upstream brand-safety review flagged risk
description: Scale a Reddit Ads test targeting niche subreddits aligned to the product category and evaluate CAC vs Google Search. Upstream dependency is brand-safety and community review outcomes from the Trust & Safety rubric; downstream dependency is reporting in Reddit Ads plus offline conversion import via AppsFlyer. This effort is cancelled because the brand-safety review flagged unacceptable adjacency risk and moderation unpredictability for the shortlisted subreddits. Capture learnings and reallocate budget to safer contextual placements.
completion_markers: Brand-safety review notes attached to the media plan with explicit rejection reasons
Budget reallocation recorded in the monthly spend sheet and updated in the forecast doc
Reddit Ads campaigns paused/never launched, and any pixels/tags removed from the test plan
Post-mortem written with alternative channels and targeting hypotheses
start_conditions: Reddit Ads account and pixel would need to be configured
Trust & Safety brand-safety rubric would need to approve subreddit list
AppsFlyer offline conversion import would need to be validated
Creative concepts would need Brand approval

title: Reconcile WMS cycle count variance for A-12 aisle (SKUs: BOLT-M8X40, NUT-M8-NYL, WASH-M8) and post inventory adjustments
description: Investigate the week-28 cycle count variance in Warehouse A, aisle A-12, focusing on three fast-mover hardware SKUs with repeated shrink signals. Pull bin-level transaction history (receipts, picks, replenishments) from the WMS and compare to handheld scan logs from Zebra TC57 devices. Identify root causes (mis-slotting, unit-of-measure mismatch, unconfirmed picks) and post approved adjustments with reason codes.
completion_markers: WMS variance report exported for aisle A-12 showing before/after on-hand for the 3 specified SKUs
At least 10 suspect transactions annotated with timestamp, user ID, and corrective action in a shared investigation log
Inventory adjustments posted in WMS with reason codes and manager approval ID for each SKU
Follow-up recount scheduled and results recorded (pass/fail) within 5 business days
start_conditions: Week-28 cycle count exception report available from WMS
Handheld scan audit logs accessible for the relevant dates
Finance-approved adjustment reason codes configured in WMS
Permission to post inventory adjustments granted to the owner

title: Negotiate spot rate and capacity guarantee for LAX→ORD air freight lane (8 pallets/week, 1,200 kg) with two forwarders
description: Request spot quotes for the LAX to ORD lane for a recurring weekly shipment profile (8 Euro-pallets, 1,200 kg total, 48-hour door-to-door) and compare accessorials, cut-off times, and cargo screening requirements. Hold a side-by-side review with Forwarder A and Forwarder B and push for a 6-week capacity guarantee and fixed fuel surcharge formula. Capture the decision in a rate sheet and update the TMS lane table.
completion_markers: Two written quotes received (PDF or email) including base rate, FSC, and at least 5 named accessorials
Selected forwarder documented with an approval note including effective dates and service level (48-hour) commitment
TMS lane table updated with new rate, FSC rule, and carrier SCAC/identifier
First booking tendered under the new rate and acknowledged by the chosen forwarder
start_conditions: Shipment profile confirmed (pallet count, weights, dimensions, weekly cadence)
List of incumbent and alternate forwarder contacts validated
TMS access to update lane/rate master granted
Finance approval threshold for spot buys confirmed

title: Implement EDI 856 ASN mapping for Walmart DC 6095 with SSCC-18 labels and UCC-128 compliance
description: Build the EDI 856 Advance Ship Notice mapping for Walmart DC 6095, ensuring correct HL hierarchy (shipment/order/pack/item) and SSCC-18 carton IDs that match printed UCC-128 labels. Validate that item GTIN, PO numbers, and quantities align with the 850/810 documents and the WMS packing confirmation feed. Run end-to-end testing through the VAN and obtain a passing 856 certification test result.
completion_markers: 856 mapping spec completed with segment-level rules for HL, LIN, SN1, and MAN (SSCC) documented
Test ASNs generated for at least 3 scenarios (single PO, multi-PO, partial shipment) and archived
Label samples show SSCC-18 on UCC-128 and match the MAN segment values in the 856
VAN/Walmart testing returns a pass confirmation or certification notice with timestamp
start_conditions: Walmart EDI implementation guide for 856 and label requirements received
WMS pack/ship confirmation feed fields (cartonization, SSCC, GTIN) available
VAN mailbox and trading partner setup completed
Test POs available for certification scenarios

title: Close temperature-excursion CAPA for refrigerated LTL shipment (Lane: Dallas→Atlanta, 2–8°C biologics)
description: Finalize the corrective and preventive action (CAPA) after a refrigerated LTL shipment recorded a 10.5°C excursion for 47 minutes on the Dallas to Atlanta lane. Review data logger traces, carrier reefer unit status, dock dwell times, and chain-of-custody scans to determine the most likely failure point. Update SOPs for pre-cool verification and dock staging limits, and document training completion for the shipping team.
completion_markers: CAPA record completed with root cause statement, containment actions, and preventive actions (document ID and revision)
Temperature logger CSV attached showing excursion window and max temperature value
Updated SOP published (new revision number) including explicit dock staging maximum time in minutes
Training roster shows 100% completion for assigned staff (names + dates) and is filed in QMS
start_conditions: Temperature logger data retrieved from device portal
Carrier incident report received including reefer status and timeline
QMS access to create/close CAPA and publish SOP revisions
List of staff requiring retraining confirmed

title: Cancel cross-dock pilot at Reno hub and archive decision log (low throughput, high damage rate)
description: Terminate the Reno cross-dock pilot after 6 weeks due to throughput below target and an elevated damage rate on mixed-SKU pallets. Notify carriers and internal stakeholders of the end date, revert routing guides to pre-pilot flows, and stop the temporary labor contract. Archive metrics (units/hour, mis-sorts, damage claims) and the formal de-scope rationale in the operations wiki.
completion_markers: Written cancellation notice sent to at least 5 stakeholders (ops, finance, carrier rep, hub lead, customer service) with effective end date
Routing guide reverted in TMS/WMS with a change ticket reference ID
Temporary labor contract termination confirmation saved (document or email)
Pilot metrics snapshot archived (throughput and damage rate figures) and linked in the decision log page
start_conditions: Pilot KPI report compiled for the full 6-week period
Access to routing guide configuration in TMS/WMS confirmed
Labor vendor contact and contract terms available
Operations wiki space available for documentation

title: Validate customs classification and duty rates for HS codes on new import kit (Port: Rotterdam, Incoterms DAP)
description: Review and confirm HS codes, product descriptions, and country-of-origin declarations for a new kitted product imported via Rotterdam under DAP terms. Cross-check broker feedback, binding tariff information where available, and ensure commercial invoice line items align with the BOM and packaging configuration. Produce a final classification sheet with duty/VAT estimates and share with finance and the customs broker for pre-clearance.
completion_markers: Classification sheet produced listing each component and kit with HS code, COO, duty rate, and VAT treatment
Commercial invoice template updated with compliant descriptions and correct line-item breakdown (kit vs components)
Broker confirmation received (email or portal note) acknowledging the HS codes for the shipment
Pre-clearance package assembled (invoice, packing list, COO statements) and stored in shared drive with a folder link
start_conditions: Bill of materials and packaging configuration for the kit finalized
Supplier COO declarations collected for each component
Broker contact established and Rotterdam entry process confirmed
Finance requires duty/VAT estimate for landed cost model

title: Resolve carrier chargebacks for detention at Port Newark (2 containers, demurrage vs detention split)
description: Investigate two Port Newark container moves that generated unexpected chargebacks and clarify whether fees are demurrage, detention, per diem, or chassis-related. Pull appointment confirmations, in-gate/out-gate timestamps, and terminal free-time rules, then compare to the carrier invoice line items. Dispute incorrect charges via the carrier portal and track credits to closure.
completion_markers: Timeline spreadsheet created for each container with at least 6 milestones (arrival, availability, appointment, out-gate, return, invoice date)
Terminal free-time policy citation attached (PDF or link) showing applicable days for demurrage/detention
Dispute submitted for each incorrect invoice line with ticket/reference numbers recorded
Credit memos or invoice revisions received and matched to original invoice numbers
start_conditions: Carrier invoices and container numbers available
Terminal portal access for in-gate/out-gate timestamps
Routing order and appointment confirmations retrieved from TMS or email
Freight audit system access to log disputes and reconcile credits

title: Complete supplier OTIF scorecard for Q2 (top 12 suppliers) and trigger corrective actions for <92% lines on-time
description: Compile Q2 supplier OTIF performance across the top 12 suppliers, using PO promise dates, ASN received timestamps, and quantity short/over metrics. Normalize for partial shipments and backorders, then publish a scorecard with line-level and PO-level OTIF. For suppliers under 92% line OTIF, open corrective action requests with specific examples (PO numbers, late days, shortages).
completion_markers: Scorecard delivered listing all 12 suppliers with PO-level OTIF %, line-level OTIF %, and defect counts
Underlying dataset includes at least these fields: supplier, PO, promised date, receipt date, lines, units short, late days
Corrective action requests created for each supplier below 92% line OTIF with at least 3 cited POs per supplier
Scorecard stored in a shared location and circulated to procurement leadership (distribution list captured)
start_conditions: PO and receipt data exported from ERP/WMS for Q2 date range
ASN feed available (or receiving timestamps) to compute on-time receipt
Supplier master list for top 12 by spend or volume confirmed
Template for corrective action requests approved by procurement

title: Cancel RFID gate reader rollout at DC3 after interference testing fails near dock doors 14–18
description: Stop the planned RFID gate reader rollout at DC3 after repeated read-rate degradation was observed near dock doors 14–18 due to RF interference and metal racking reflections. Document test conditions (tag type, antenna placement, forklift traffic) and the measured read rates, and notify IT and facilities that the rollout is paused indefinitely. Close the purchase order for remaining hardware and return unused equipment per vendor RMA.
completion_markers: Interference test report filed including at least 3 test runs with measured read-rate percentages and locations
Rollout cancellation notice sent to IT, DC3 leadership, and vendor with explicit scope stopped (doors 14–18 and remaining phases)
PO closed or reduced for remaining hardware with ERP transaction reference
RMA initiated and shipment tracking number recorded for returned equipment
start_conditions: RFID pilot test logs and measurement method available
Hardware vendor return policy and RMA process confirmed
ERP procurement access to close or modify POs
Stakeholder distribution list for DC3 rollout maintained

title: Remove outbound hazmat mis-declaration risk: update DG checklist for UN3481 lithium batteries (Section II) and retrain packout team
description: Update the dangerous goods (DG) outbound checklist to prevent mis-declarations for UN3481 lithium batteries packed with equipment under IATA Section II rules. Verify package marking/labeling, watt-hour thresholds, and shipper’s declaration requirements by scenario, then align the checklist with the WMS shipping screen prompts. Retrain the packout team and validate compliance via a sample audit of recent shipments.
completion_markers: DG checklist updated and version-controlled with explicit decision steps for UN3481 Section II vs other cases
WMS shipping prompts updated or a work instruction issued that references specific screen fields to complete
Training session completed with attendance list (names + dates) for all packout staff on the roster
Post-training audit performed on at least 20 outbound parcels with results logged and zero critical findings
start_conditions: Current DG checklist and shipping work instructions retrieved
IATA lithium battery guidance for applicable year available
Packout staff roster and training scheduling access confirmed
Sample set of recent lithium-battery shipments identifiable in WMS
